conflicts.issue: LICENSE and README identify CC BY 4.0, while guidelines claim CC BY SA. Version and share-alike scope cannot be silently harmonized.
Two approvals, reduction after 14 days and maintainer veto require capacity and risk review; age cannot silently weaken an adopted gate.
Template grants maintainers admin access; least-privilege role design may require a narrower local scope.
Present-behavior restriction requires a deliberate incident-handling interpretation and cannot erase actionable historical evidence by default.
Removal of templates, security or citation files is conditional template guidance, not authorization to delete active safeguards.
